scope: Independent common-range abstract execution vs frozen typed graph constraint crosscheck
modelScope: Complete committed point-register histories with unique per-key producers and explicit complete final-write orders. No event/ACK/session/array/search ordering facts.

graph.nodes: Every input transaction; reversible ordinal mapping is encoding only, never an ordering constraint.
graph.ww: Adjacent committed writer final versions in each explicitly supplied factual order, excluding initializer as a node.
graph.wr: Every read from another transaction final write induces writer→reader; original read/write locations retained.
graph.rw-item: Every initial/external-final read induces reader→the immediate successor final writer in that explicit key order, skipping self edges. Own legitimate reads induce no external dependencies.
graph.source: Every original edge retains exact key/read/program index/factual order indices and original symbolic identities.
graph.prohibited: No inferred order completion, ACK/transaction-array order, arbitration witness or search order is added as a fact.

directObligations: INT same-key last program operation; same-transaction future write source; external nonfinal source. They are retained separately and never relabelled as a cycle. Coverage/capacity/structure exclusions do not yield graph model decisions.
independentGraphTruth: Serial rejection iff D union RW contains any directed cycle. Generalized-SI rejection iff H=D union D;RW contains any directed cycle, with D=WW/WR. H explicitly materialized as Boolean reachability macro graph over original nodes, independently of kernel product states/SCC implementation.
budgets: Oracle budget-unknown is reported as unknown without comparing a mathematical graph truth to a model verdict. Kernel inconclusive remains unknown and never absence. All inputs and exclusions counted.
witness: Kernel edges must equal frozen originals and form category-valid closed walks; GSI macro grouping independently checked. Abstract witnesses are independently replayed from explicit initial/final values and visibility cuts; not capture facts.
